title: A machine-learning potential predicts reconstruction at a twisted SrTiO₃ interface
summary: A density-functional-theory-trained machine-learning potential predicted near-interface reconstruction at a twisted SrTiO₃ interface, which the study compared with atomic-resolution microscopy. The structural result concerns the prepared interface; electronic and switching outcomes are not attributed to the AI prediction.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed arXiv metadata

evidence.tested: The predicted near-interface reconstruction was compared with the observed atomic structure in microscopy.
evidence.unknown: The result concerns the studied twisted SrTiO₃ interface; electronic and switching outcomes are not attributed to the AI prediction.
evidence.ai_role: A learned interatomic potential predicted atomic reconstruction for comparison with experimental microscopy.
